Solicitation Description   36C24826R0132 Replace Miami VAMC Building 1 Roof, Project No. 546-24-129
The Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office 8 (NCO 8), is issuing this Request for Proposal (RFP) under FAR Part 15 to replace the roofing system on Building 1 at the Bruce W. Carter VA Medical Center, 1201 NW 16th Street, Miami, FL 33125.
Scope of work: The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, and services needed to remove and replace about 214,637 square feet of roofing on Building 1. Work shall follow the drawings, specifications, and Statement of Work. The project includes:
phased construction
demolition of the existing roofing system
installation of the new roofing system
removal and reinstallation of the photovoltaic panels
replacement of the Lightning Protection System
manufacturer inspections and certifications
all related work needed to keep disruption to hospital operations to a minimum
NAICS Code: 238160, Roofing Contractors Small Business Size Standard: $19.0 million Magnitude of Construction: Between $10,000,000 and $20,000,000, per VAAR 836.204 Period of Performance: 1,095 calendar days after receipt of the Notice to Proceed
Set-Aside: This procurement is set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) under 38 U.S.C. Â§ 8127, using a tiered set-aside evaluation under VAAR 819.7010. SDVOSB offers will be evaluated first, then VOSB offers, then other small business offers, then large business offers. A lower tier will be evaluated only if no award can be made at a higher tier.
Basis for Award: Best value to the Government. All non-price factors combined are significantly more important than price.
Important Dates:
Site Visit: Friday, December 4, 2026, at 9:00 AM EST
Requests for Information (RFIs) Due: Wednesday, December 9, 2026, at 11:00 AM EST
Proposals Due: Monday, December 28, 2026, at 11:00 AM EST
Registration: When proposals are submitted and at award, offerors must be actively registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://www.sam.gov. Offerors submitting as SDVOSBs or VOSBs must also be certified by the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) and listed in SBA's Small Business Search (SBS) at https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of proposal submission and at the time of award. A joint venture may be considered eligible as an SDVOSB/VOSB if it complies with 13 CFR 128.402.
Availability of Funds: Funds are not currently available for this procurement. No award will be made until appropriated funds become available (FAR 52.232-18).
